test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Statements:

1. No pens are pencils.

2. Some pencils are erasers.

Conclusions:

I. Some erasers are not pens.

II. No pens are erasers.
solution:
**Statements:**

1. No pens are pencils.

2. Some pencils are erasers.

The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34a4f7387e461902d3547984bb3b168a176b2f789bd54778a590a994c3b9c14f.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some erasers are not pens -**True**(because Some erasers are pencils and no pencils are pen, it implies that the part of eraser is pencil can never be pen).

II. No pens are erasers - False(because there is no definite relation is given so it can be possible only).

Thus, Only I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
